concept.concept: Stack of illustrated books with dog-eared pages and text 'I'm Currently Reading Four Books Simultaneously and Finishing None'
concept.audience: Avid readers, book club members, and BookTok community who relate to ambitious reading lists
concept.rationale: BookTok-driven reading identity is at peak cultural moment; tote is the natural book-carrier product; humor is deeply relatable and shareable, strong organic word-of-mouth potential

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I'm Currently Reading Four Books Simultaneously and Finishing None" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a tilted stack of four hardcover books, each with dog-eared pages folded down at the corners, stacked at slightly different angles leaning to one side. Books in solid color blocks: deep navy, burnt orange, forest green, and cream. Bold retro serif typeface arched above the stack in black, reading 'I'm Currently Reading Four Books Simultaneously and Finishing None'. Single centered composition on a plain white background with generous margins. Screen-print aesthetic, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast, solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: I'm Currently Reading Four Books Simultaneously and Finishing None
design.style: flat vector illustration, screen-print aesthetic, bold retro serif, solid color blocks: navy, burnt orange, forest green, cream, black text, no gradients, no shading
